description: Assign a lead to a workspace member by user id, or pass assignedTo=null to unassign. Use search_leads to find the lead id and get_workspace_info to confirm the operating workspace. The result echoes the operating workspace.

assignedTo.description: User id of the workspace member to assign the lead to. Pass null to unassign.

id.description: The lead id returned by search_leads.

name: assign_lead
title: Assign lead
